title: The Evolving Terrain of the Global AI Transformation
summary: The race to build ever more powerful AI models is heating up, but so far there is little evidence of the promised productivity surge. Whether that changes will depend on how quickly employers adopt AI and whether governments can encourage its use while managing the risks of job losses and public backlash.

title: How Congress Can Give Americans What They Want
summary: American households are footing the bill for President Donald Trump’s tariffs and war in Iran through higher prices and borrowing costs. Congress has the power to stop this by reclaiming its authority over tariff policy and the use of military force, and by requiring a public accounting of the costs of future wars.

title: The Revolt Against Oligarchy
summary: The extraordinary power wielded by today’s billionaires is a threat to democracy and the planet. Encouragingly, people around the world, frustrated by a lack of affordability and worsening job prospects, are beginning to discover just how much political power they can wield.
